column1: # Ids the app builds at run time from a parameter, so no literal in apps/mobile/Monaco spells them out.
# scripts/qa/journey.py check turns each row into a pattern: <name> stands for any id text, and a journey target
# that matches a pattern counts as set. A row fails check when its file has no accessibilityIdentifier( call with a
# computed argument, or when the fixed text of the pattern is not in that file, so a row cannot outlive its code.
# Columns: pattern, the file that composes it, why.
